independence: Reviewer did not author or modify the four reviewed implementation/test files. Earlier role was source/backup recovery and evidence-ledger preparation.
scope: Pinned completed D3 consumer and cooperative shared runner; one static pass plus one focused compact-catalogue/receipt readback.

checks.evidence: Source commit/vendor digests, per-result raw/tail/prefix identities, common-grid/full-state shape, compact NPZ hash/index alignment and exact receipt membership. Original archive pin is supplied by the already verified restore/authority receipt; this review does not redownload the archive.

Missing original P_m_i becomes 0, P_r_i falls back to original Pi_F_signed_i. Exact 237 unique IDs, 175 joint, 91 baseline, 6 guards and joint Cartesian grid are enforced. Current compact catalogue readback: 237 unique, 6 guards, 94 zero-matter rows including 3 guards.

Completed receipt requires exact equality; conflicting local result raises and is preserved. Global invalid/prior/partial receipts are terminal preservation states. Immutable case/attempt writes use atomic link without replacement; mutable run reports/registry pointers are separate. Source full raw is opened read-only by the consumer.

Per-case identity and shared cpu_<id>.lock use flock LOCK_NB. Busy case skips to others. CPU/case descriptors pass to the owned child. Affinity, quota and observed physical/cgroup headroom, reserved CPU/RAM and worker ceiling constrain admission; current available RAM is not debited for existing worker usage twice.

Only Popen objects created by this coordinator enter active. terminate/kill target those direct children. No process-name sweep, pkill, or signalling of discovered external jobs. Existing current run receipt has zero starts and zero other-job signals.

OMP/OpenBLAS/MKL/BLIS/NumExpr/VECLIB/Rayon are set to 1; nested OpenMP disabled. Environment is applied before API import in runner/worker and passed to Popen. CPU affinity is assigned for each owned child.

One focused read-only check against current compact catalogue and local completion receipts returned REUSED_COMPLETE=237 and pending=0. It did not invoke runner.run, observe resources, acquire locks, start workers, or import original scientific model/solver.

The existing eight-test PASS receipt hashes exactly match current shared_runner.py and test_runner.py. Tests cover resource caps, active-memory accounting, lease conflict independence, immutable writes, invalid registry preservation, real file-only toy workers and cross-output-root reuse. No broad test rerun.
